source_title: Stateful Artificial Intelligence (AI) runtime environment for isolated stateful execution of AI agent workflows (US20260267689A1)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 patent publication with stateful agent runtime, execution-boundary checkpoints, serialized persistent state, suspension, rehydration/resumption, layered memory, and driver/extensibility concepts; strong pressure against broad checkpoint/resume and stateful-runtime formulations, especially Claims 1 and 9-15
notes: Published six days before P1 and claims priority to 2025-03-06. Search review found explicit suspension at execution boundaries/checkpoints, serialization of agent state, later rehydration/resumption, and platform/driver extensibility. This is potentially material adverse art and must receive limitation-level mapping against operative Claims 1-20, with particular attention to what it does NOT teach: Person-State-driven feasible-action recomputation, correction/supersession/provenance filtering, bounded permission-scoped resume packages, transcript-independent provider handoff, and the exact Claim 15 combination. Do not infer those missing elements without charting. Preserve for IDS/materiality review.
